description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Scheming Symmetry and Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Cast Scheming Symmetry by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Seasons Past from your library.
Repeat.
